description: How to install or run a GitHub repository: whether it works on macOS, Windows or Linux (with reasons), ready-made downloads, install commands from the README, the parts it needs, and step-by-step commands to set it up from source. Facts come from the repo's own files, not guesses.

arch.description: The user's CPU, for picking the right download (Apple Silicon is arm64).

os.description: Only this system. Leave out for all three.

repo.description: The GitHub repo: "owner/repo" or a github.com link, e.g. "ollama/ollama".

name: get_setup_manual
title: Get a repo's setup manual
